assumptions: Header variants differing only in capitalisation/spacing (globigerinoides ruber, Neogloboquadrina  incompta, Globorotalia Inflata) are the same species and their counts were summed.
issues: Raw file has 11 columns but only 8 distinct species due to transcription variants; merged via study map_taxa.
The toolkit PAST reader splits on whitespace and needs a '.' header, so I wrote counts_past.txt (header '.', spaces in names replaced with underscores); counts unchanged.
summary: Merged 3 duplicate taxon columns (8 species), ran Bray-Curtis on raw counts via palaeo study (study3), and averaged the 45 pairwise distances over 10 samples.
